_note: Things every Modern Muscle cockpit root carries. CockpitRoot_DoNotRename is cloned at install time from the live Piercer cockpit named in rootDonorCockpitId, so size (7.5 x 1.2 x 10.5), material, physical properties and the TemplateRole attribute match. Its children are then moved or rebuilt as listed here. Positions are root local (+X right, +Y up, forward -Z). The Z and X values come from the frame datums in scripts/vehicle_blockouts/specs/muscle.json (standard.datums), not from the Exotic file.
_rootDonorChildren: The exact child list of the donor root, verified live 2026-10-02 (the same donor as Exotic). The audit stops if the live donor differs. The two lens names end in a space, as on the live Piercer.
_hoverDust: Under the four lift-jet arches: Z = frontArchZ -7.6 and rearArchZ 8.3; X 4.7 is the middle of the lift-jet envelope (3.4 to 6.0). Height as Piercer and Exotic (-1.375).

underglow._removeLightsUnderMount: The donor (bruiser_03) has a SurfaceLight parented straight to the mount Attachment. A SurfaceLight needs a part face, so emitter Parts under UNDERGLOW_EMITTERS_DoNotRename are used instead (as COCKPIT_BRUISER_02 and Exotic).
underglow._emitters: One invisible slab just under the floor (floor datum Y -0.4; bottom face at Y -0.45). Length 24: nose shelf Z -12.3 to tail face Z 12.1 (centre -0.1). Width 9: inside the door skins (X 4.75). Light values as Exotic. Enabled=false in the template; VehicleCosmeticCatalog.ApplyPresentation sets Enabled and Color from the saved cosmetic state.

_lenses: The two invisible light-source parts cloned with the donor root. Rotation and light properties stay as the donor has them; only the position moves: the nose shelf (noseShelfZ -12.3) and the tail face (tailFaceZ 12.1), at lamp height between the sill (0.3) and the beltline (3.3).
